mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in nonfarm payrolls indicates labor market strength that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production during late-cycle contraction signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines in late-cycle.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in nonfarm payrolls over 6 months indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1,400,000 units signals weakening housing market conditions that reduce consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1400.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and fall in unemployment rate indicates monetary tightening in response to labor market strength, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening amid strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth during early-cycle expansion signals improving economic conditions that boost corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive in early-cycle.
